in_marathi.name: Baskaran
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baskaran हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baskara is a Sanskrit name derived from the Tamil word 'Baskar,' which means 'God's treasure.' This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is often depicted holding a mace called a 'Baskara' in his hand. The name Baskaran signifies the presence of divine blessings, wealth, and prosperity.
